frozen_consequence_surface.primary_measure_sampling_rule: At each horizon, use the last lawful current-segment returned observer state available as-of the horizon bar; compare the same frozen task invariant; source break/release end censors.

contract_gap.missing_required_definition: No frozen repository or controlling G0 record defines the exact task-invariant projection/equality predicate that maps an origin whole-observer state and an as-of-horizon whole-observer state to TASK_INVARIANT_PRESERVED_AT_H.
contract_gap.r1_requirement: BCWT-R1 states that a later ObserverTaskPredicatePack may define invariant-preserved-at-horizon only after its predicates and first-valid semantics are frozen in BCWT-R3.
contract_gap.r3_record_observation: BCWT-R3-G0 freezes the measure name and horizon sampling rule but does not define the task-invariant fields, canonical projection, unavailable-state treatment, or equality/preservation rule.
contract_gap.why_execution_is_forbidden: Choosing those semantics after G1 and after scientific consequence access would be a material frozen-contract semantic change and could make the primary outcome post-hoc. The G1 authority grants execution only inside the exact prebound envelope; it does not grant semantic completion or amendment.

smallest_lawful_resolution: Operator-governed successor semantic amendment: explicitly define and freeze the task-invariant projection/equality and missingness semantics before any R4 consequence payload is computed. Because this changes a load-bearing frozen consequence predicate, preserve generation 1 and G0/G1 history append-only and issue the required successor/amendment authority rather than silently filling the gap.
